name: Green Bean, Chickpea & Sun-Dried Tomato Salad with Feta & Olives

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and position rack in the centre. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Rinse the green beans. Trim ends, halve, and transfer to the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.681 kg green beans
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and roast until lightly charred, 10-15 minutes.
Rinse the chickpeas and set aside to drain.
Peel and mince the garlic. Grate zest from the lemons. In a large bowl, whisk together the minced garlic, lemon zest and juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
zest and juice of 1 ½ lemon
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash the tomatoes and parsley. Halve the tomatoes and add to the bowl. Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems, chop the leaves, and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pkg grape tomatoes
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Halve the olives and add to the bowl.
Thinly slice the sun-dried tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Stir in the chickpeas, green beans, and feta. Toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place salad on a plate and enjoy!
